data.summary: Amit has a 1BHK in Kharadi (about 550 sq ft) and wanted the kitchen and one bedroom done. He volunteered a budget that is well below what that scope would need; the agent explained this kindly without repeating the figure and closed the call.

entities.notes_for_designer: Caller's stated budget was well below the scope; politely declined.

data.transcript:
[14:04:12] AGENT: Namaste, thank you for calling Aangan Studio. I'm Aangan's AI assistant, and this call is recorded so our designers have your details. How can I help you today?

[14:04:20] USER: Hi. I have a 1BHK in Kharadi, about 550 square feet. I want to do the kitchen and one bedroom.

[14:04:30] AGENT: Thank you for calling. May I have your name?

[14:04:33] USER: Amit.

[14:04:36] AGENT: Thank you, Amit. A kitchen and a bedroom, designed and executed. Is that right?

[14:04:41] USER: Yes. My budget is 1 to 1.5 lakh maximum for everything. Is that possible with you?

[14:04:50] AGENT: Thank you for being upfront. The budget you mentioned would be well below what a project of that scope costs with us, so I wouldn't want to bring you to a consultation that doesn't work for you.

[14:05:04] USER: Even for one bedroom?

[14:05:07] AGENT: Even for one room, I'm afraid. Our projects include full design and execution, and I'd rather be honest with you now.

[14:05:16] USER: Okay, thank you for being straight.

[14:05:19] AGENT: This sounds like it may not be the right fit for us right now — but please do reach out if your timeline or scope changes. Thank you for calling, Amit.
